title: How To Get FREE Victoria's Secret Samples
description: Start getting free samples here: getsamplesonlinenow.co

asr.full_text: OK so the first way to get free Victoria's Secret underwear is to subscribe to their mailing list. Victoria's Secret will send you catalogues and also Coupons. So by subscribing to their mailing list and also their email subscription you will get coupons for free panties or other free products or money off. Another way to get Victoria's Secret panties for free is to follow Victoria's Secret and Victoria's Secret Pink on their social medias. And a lot of the times they'll do random freebies and they'll give away free panties or free other things or coupons for free things too. Victoria's Secret also has an app, or I guess it's Victoria's Secret Pink. It's called Pink Nation and that app is so fun. A lot of times they'll have games and giveaways and like contests going on and they give away free coupons and free items. So I like to check on there like a couple times a week and yeah I have like one different coupons just from like playing their game so it's kind of fun so I'll check that out and then if you have a Victoria's Secret credit card or Victoria's Secret pink credit card they send you coupons all the time more than when you're just signed up for their mailing list or like they're mailing an email subscription they send a ton of coupons a lot of them are for free panties or other products or money off your purchase and every month they will send you a gift card too. Then, it's really awesome!
